visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair in a sleek ponytail, wearing a white ribbed tank top and deep blue denim pants, stands in front of a wide concrete fountain. She smiles warmly at the camera, making a peace sign and then moving her hands in a rhythmic, rotating fashion. The background features lush green trees and modern urban buildings under a soft, overcast sky. (2) The scene cuts to the woman standing directly in front of the iconic, large-scale Olympic rings sculpture in a public plaza. She continues her dance with fluid arm swings and precise hand gestures, looking cheerful and engaged with the viewer. The ground is paved with stone, and the lighting is even and natural from the cloudy daylight. (3) The location shifts to a grassy park area where a giant white Ferris wheel is prominently visible in the distant background. The woman performs a saluting motion while swaying her torso and continuing her rhythmic dance routine. Her facial expressions remain bright and energetic, and several small figures of passers-by are visible walking in the background. (4) In the final sequence, she is seen in front of classical architectural pillars and a dark bronze statue, with a black jacket now tied around her waist. She moves her arms in a series of synchronized, stylized motions before the video cuts back to the Olympic rings for a final energetic pose and a playful smile.
